entries.title: I Samuel 3:1
segments: ¶And the boy Samuel ministered to Jehovah before Eli. And the word of Jehovah was rare in those days; a vision was not frequent.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:2
segments: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli lay in his place (now his eyes began to grow dim, he could not see),

entries.title: I Samuel 3:3
segments: and the lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel lay in the temple of Jehovah, where the ark of God was,

entries.title: I Samuel 3:4
segments: that Jehovah called to Samuel. And he said, Here am I.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:5
segments: And he ran to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I did not call: lie down again. And he went and lay down.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:6
segments: And Jehovah called again, Samuel! And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I did not call, my son: lie down again.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:7
segments: Now Samuel did not yet know Jehovah, neither had the word of Jehovah yet been revealed to him.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:8
segments: And Jehovah called again the third time, Samuel! And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And Eli perceived that Jehovah was calling the boy.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:9
segments: And Eli said to Samuel, Go, lie down; and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, Jehovah, for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:10
segments: And Jehovah came, and stood, and called as at the other times, Samuel, Samuel! And Samuel said, Speak, for thy servant heareth.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:11
segments: ¶And Jehovah said to Samuel, Behold, I do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:12
segments: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house; I will begin and make an end.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:13
segments: For I have declared to him that I will judge his house for ever, for the iniquity which he hath known: because his sons made themselves vile, and he restrained them not.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:14
segments: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be expiated with sacrifice or oblation for ever.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:15
segments: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of Jehovah. And Samuel feared to declare the vision to Eli.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:16
segments: And Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he said, Here am I.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:17
segments: And he said, What is the word that he has spoken to thee? I pray thee, keep it not back from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou keep back anything from me of all the word that he spoke to thee.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:18
segments: And Samuel told him all the words, and kept nothing back from him. And he said, It is Jehovah: let him do what is good in his sight.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:19
segments: ¶And Samuel grew, and Jehovah was with him, and let none of his words fall to the ground.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:20
segments: And all Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, knew that Samuel was established a prophet of Jehovah.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:21
segments: And Jehovah appeared again at Shiloh; for Jehovah revealed himself to Samuel at Shiloh by the word of Jehovah.
